With force: true, Rails drops any existing embeddable_hosts table before creating it, silently destroying data — e.g., if the migration is re-run, or in environments where the table already exists (restored databases, concurrent/older migrations). This is a real data-loss hazard introduced by the diff, not style.

While migrations normally run once, this is a real, diff-grounded risk during re-run/redo or in restored/partially-migrated environments and can cause silent data loss, so the reviewer concern is valid even if it may not manifest in the typical one-time migration path.
